title: Custo target organizations
description: Repository discovery scope for the Sync Managed Files workflow.

scope.description: all-access discovers all repositories visible to the current app installation token; organizations restricts discovery to listed organizations.

organizations.description: GitHub organization logins to scan when scope is organizations.

enabled.description: When true, Custo synchronizes custom-property definitions before repository sync.

scope.description: Where to maintain custom-property schema definitions.

enterprise.description: Enterprise slug used for enterprise-level custom-property schema.

typePropertyName.description: Custom-property name for repository type. Defaults to Type.

subscriptionPropertyName.description: Custom-property name for subscribed file sets. Defaults to SubscribeTo.
